purpose: Foundation experiments: latent scorer evaluation + basic evolution
notes: Discovered latent scorer has ~0 correlation. Hyperbolic maintains diversity but no quality signal.

purpose: Tree traversal tasks on Qwen3-1.7B
notes: Model too small (1.7B). Both geometries fail at depth 5+. Need >= 4B.

purpose: Hyperbolic vs Euclidean with verifiable arithmetic on Qwen3-4B
notes: Prompt 1 +25% hyp, Prompt 2 +25% euc. Exactly opposite = high variance. Single-prompt results unreliable.

purpose: 5-seed statistical rigor test with McNemar
notes: Consistent +8% hyp advantage. Depth 3 strongest (+33.3%). No individual seed p<0.05.

purpose: Curvature sweep [0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0] focused on depth 2-3
notes: c=0.5 dominates at depth 3 (+70% vs Euclidean). Lower curvature better for moderate depth.

purpose: Validate c=0.5 finding on 1.7B vs 4B models
notes: Model capacity matters. 1.7B: Euc wins. 4B: Hyp wins. Codex: 'plausible early signal, not breakthrough'.

purpose: Rigorous 5-seed run with proper statistical controls
notes: No signal. p=0.18. Evolution fitness=0.000 everywhere. Latent scorer completely blind.

purpose: Dense reward + constrained Euclidean baseline
notes: INVALIDATED by Codex review. 10 issues found (4 critical). Loose verifier + magnitude normalization inflated results.

purpose: Fix all 10 Codex-identified V10 issues
notes: All 10 issues fixed. Codex grade: A-. Same RNG seed all conditions, matched ball radii, per-seed McNemar, etc.

purpose: Codex full repository review
notes: Key verdict: Evidence that conditioning bandwidth matters, not that hyperbolic geometry improves reasoning. RNG-seed is the bottleneck. Soft prompt works because high-bandwidth.

purpose: Geometry isolation: hyp vs euc under identical soft prompt conditioning
notes: Evolution HURTS (90% -> 60%). Goodhart's Law: dense_score != task quality. Geometry doesn't matter when fitness is broken.

purpose: Cross-model conditioning comparison: pure vs soft prompt vs RNG seed on 4 Qwen3 sizes
notes: Both conditioning methods eliminate phantom hallucination. Non-monotonic scaling: RNG wins at 0.6B/8B, soft prompt wins at 4B/14B. Pure model always worst.

purpose: Test if different random soft prompt latents produce different accuracy
notes: WEAKLY EXPLOITABLE. Baseline 100%, 4/5 latents fail on 1 hard task (6-step chain, answer=9338). Failure mode: chain management disruption. Direction matters (Latent 1 preserves accuracy). Need harder tasks for positive signal.

purpose: Test landscape exploitability with nested expression tasks (no scaffolding)
notes: Cochran Q=23.2 (p=0.006): latents differ significantly from each other. 32% range. Best latent 96% vs 92% baseline. But 0/10 latents individually significant vs baseline (binomial p>0.05 all). Signal is inter-latent variance, not consistent improvement over baseline.

purpose: Test landscape exploitability on harder sweet-spot tasks (~60% target baseline)
notes: All 10 latents beat baseline (32%). 3/10 individually significant (binomial p<0.05): L6=56% (p=0.011), L3=52% (p=0.030), L8=52% (p=0.030). BUT Cochran Q=8.3 (p=0.504) NOT significant - latents don't differ from EACH OTHER enough. Mean improvement +12.4%. Thinking mode required (5.7h runtime).

purpose: Test landscape exploitability WITHOUT thinking mode (no-think)
notes: CRITICAL FINDING: No-think landscape is FLAT (4% range vs 32% with thinking). Chain-of-thought IS the steering mechanism. Soft prompts only influence output through reasoning chains. No-think useful for speed but NOT for finding improvements. CUDA error after L10 (VRAM accumulation).

purpose: Random-noise control: does latent direction matter or is improvement from any soft prompt tokens?
notes: WARM-START CONFIRMED. Random noise (44.0%) matches latent-projected (44.4%), Mann-Whitney p=1.0. Latent direction carries no signal. Improvement (+12pp) comes from presence of 8 extra embedding tokens at correct RMS, not from what they contain. Entire latent-to-W pipeline is irrelevant. Core thesis falsified.

purpose: V15b: Geometry isolation with accuracy-based fitness (fixes Goodhart from V15a)
notes: Evolution still hurts (-4%) even with accuracy fitness. Geometry doesn't matter (68% = 68%). Local mutation can't exploit 32% global range. Next: global search (random sampling, CMA-ES, QD with large noise).

purpose: Replicate noise control on easy tasks to confirm direction-agnostic warm-start across difficulty levels
notes: 4/5 noise vectors completed. Noise=latent (p=1.0) on easy tasks. Cross-validates sweet-spot result. Core thesis falsification confirmed across both difficulty regimes.

purpose: Test if attention extension alone (zero embeddings) suffices for warm-start
notes: Zero tokens +4pp vs baseline 32%. Random diverse +12pp. Embedding VALUES matter, computational depth alone insufficient.

purpose: Test if token diversity matters (8 identical mean-embedding tokens)
notes: Mean embedding (36%) = zero embedding (36%). Token DIVERSITY is key mechanism, not just having nonzero values.

purpose: Test minimal dose: does 1 random token capture the warm-start effect?
notes: 1 token captures 89% of 8-token effect. Threshold/trigger mechanism, not cumulative.

purpose: Classify per-task failure patterns across conditions
notes: Redistribution not improvement. Codex CLI validated: trajectory perturbation / attractor switching.

purpose: 2-token dose-response: test non-monotonic token count effect
notes: NON-MONOTONIC PEAK: 2 tokens gives 60% (best of any condition). Zero variance across 3 latents. Contradicts threshold/saturation story. 7 tasks fixed, 2 regressed vs baseline.

purpose: Decompose perturbation: think-mode gating vs noise-specific contribution
config_path: Manual: prepend <think> to force think mode
command: Manual force-think test on 25 sweet-spot tasks
notes: Think mode alone: +8pp (32->40%). Noise beyond think at 2-tok: +20pp (40->60%). Noise contributes 2.5x more than think mode.

purpose: Comprehensive statistical analysis + 2 paper figures (dose-response, oracle coverage)
notes: Codex-validated analysis. Oracle efficiency is main empirical payoff. 24 gains / 3 losses pooled sign test. Medium effect size.

purpose: 3-token dose-response: 10 random noise directions, 25 sweet-spot nested tasks
notes: 3-tok equalization DEAD (p=0.335, NS). Oracle 20/25=80% adds NO tasks beyond 2-tok oracle (22/25=88%). Non-monotonic peak at 2 tokens CONFIRMED.

purpose: EXISTENTIAL test: 2-tok equalization at n=10 directions
notes: EQUALIZATION DEAD (p=0.659). [15,15,15] at n=3 was small-sample noise. Oracle 25/25=100% (up from 22/25). Zero frozen tasks. nest_008 cracked by N5. Mean 51.6% still dominates 3-tok 44%.

purpose: Test whether perturbation activates <think> mode via first-token logit probe

metrics.conclusion: No mode gating effect. <think> saturated at >99.99% for all conditions.

notes: CRITICAL: Invalidates think-mode gating claim. Model always generates <think> first (>99.99%). The 16% baseline think rate was a visibility artifact. Paper updated to remove gating framing, add trajectory modulation narrative.

purpose: Shi et al. discrete token control: / and ? at 2 tokens vs continuous random noise
notes: Continuous > discrete by 9.6pp. / barely above baseline (+4pp), ? substantial (+16pp). Supports positioning: continuous space has richer structure.

purpose: Cross-model validation: Qwen3-1.7B 2-tok n=3
command: python -u experiments/run_latent_sensitivity.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --task-type nested --difficulty sweet_spot --n-tasks 25 --n-latents 3 --control-mode random_noise --num-soft-tokens 2
notes: Effect does NOT replicate on smaller same-family model. +1.3pp mean, within noise. Boundary condition.

purpose: Cross-model validation: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 2-tok n=3
command: python -u experiments/run_latent_sensitivity.py --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B --task-type nested --difficulty sweet_spot --n-tasks 25 --n-latents 3 --control-mode random_noise --num-soft-tokens 2
notes: Effect REPLICATES on reasoning-distilled model. +5.3pp mean, oracle 100% from k=3. Task selectivity present.

purpose: Cross-model validation: phi-2 2-tok n=3 (out-of-family)
command: python -u experiments/run_latent_sensitivity.py --model microsoft/phi-2 --task-type nested --difficulty sweet_spot --n-tasks 25 --n-latents 3 --control-mode random_noise --num-soft-tokens 2
notes: Out-of-family positive\! +6.7pp mean on phi-2 (Microsoft, 2.7B). Low baseline limits absolute delta but relative improvement is 56%.

purpose: Cross-model validation: Qwen3-8B 2-tok n=3
command: python -u experiments/run_latent_sensitivity.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-8B --task-type nested --difficulty sweet_spot --n-tasks 25 --n-latents 3 --control-mode random_noise --num-soft-tokens 2
notes: NULL result. 8B at 4-bit BELOW 4B baseline. Quantization confound. Strikingly similar to 1.7B null (+1.3pp, oracle 44%, 2 regressions).

purpose: Qwen3-8B at 8-bit quantization: adjudicates whether 4-bit null is quantization artifact
command: python -u experiments/run_latent_sensitivity.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-8B --task-type nested --difficulty sweet_spot --n-tasks 25 --n-latents 3 --control-mode random_noise --num-soft-tokens 2 --quantization 8bit
notes: STRONGLY POSITIVE. Reverses 4-bit null. Quantization x noise interaction is first-class finding. 8-bit preserves richer trajectory landscape.
